title: Token budget as first-class run terminator (90/10 reserve, bad-attempt cap, per-tool accounting)
description: Extend the existing USD cost-cap (src/runs/cost-cap.ts, bridge-enforced mid-run cancel) with a per-run TOKEN budget: 90% regular / 10% reserve split, maxBadAttempts consecutive-failure terminator, early-exit when the harness reports confident completion, per-tool token accounting surfaced in run events. Source: node-DeepResearch TokenTracker (see ubuntu-ce68).

title: Maker≠checker enforcement: verifier subagent with different model/instructions; block self-grading
description: Independent verifier subagent (different model + instructions from the implementer) runs after a plan-run child succeeds and before reap marks it succeeded; verifies against the plan's acceptance criteria. Block self-grading: the implementer never verifies its own output. Rationale: DeepMind x MIT - independent agents amplify errors 17.2x vs centralized 4.4x (see ubuntu-19cc).
